verdict.rationale: Exa's Websets feature is explicitly designed for bulk operations—searching, verifying, and enriching many items at once with async processing and webhooks (exa-docs-8, exa-docs-15, exa-docs-9, exa-docs-21, exa-gh-5)—but hands-on community testing reports verification getting stuck indefinitely and poor accuracy (14 misses, 30/70 hit rate) when running bulk searches (exa-comm-3, exa-comm-4).
